subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the final rebased set of 14 third-party action revisions become OpenClaw's trusted execution boundary for these secret-bearing and publishing workflows?
rationale: The patch has no concrete correctness defect, but CI cannot decide whether maintainers trust new executable third-party revisions that receive credentials or publish security and release outputs.

options.title: Approve verified pins
options.body: Accept the grouped update after confirming every SHA against its official release and reviewing the final exact-head workflow diff.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker publishing, and CodeQL revisions from low-privilege setup-action bumps for narrower trust review.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Pause or close the update if any target revision or final merged workflow behavior cannot be confidently verified.

recommendation.title: Approve verified pins
recommendation.body: Accept the grouped update after confirming every SHA against its official release and reviewing the final exact-head workflow diff.
